_readme: Every link and button on the site points to one of these entries (or to a section on the page). status: 'in-page' = jumps to a section of this page; 'existing-site' = a page that exists on the current live website (confirmed from the saved copy of nexusresearchnx.com, 2026-11-02); 'needs-confirmation' = works, but the owner has not confirmed it is the right destination. The build refuses links that are not listed here. LINKS.md is generated from this file.

home.note: Back to the top of the homepage.

skip.used_by: 'Skip to content' keyboard link (hidden until focused)
skip.note: Accessibility link for keyboard and screen-reader users.

approach.used_by: Nav 'Our Approach', hero 'Our Approach', footer 'Our Approach'

tests.used_by: Nav 'What We Test', hero 'Explore Our Work', footer 'What We Test'

header-cta.used_by: Header button 'Explore Our Work' (desktop header and mobile menu)
header-cta.note: Goes to Current Tests, the same as the hero button with the same label. The approved preview shows an external-link arrow on this button; if it should open another page instead, name that page.

about.note: Goes to 'Research that leads somewhere' (What NEXUS is building), the section that describes NEXUS. The current live site also has an About page (https://nexusresearchnx.com/about/); its wording describes the older site, so it was not used.

privacy.note: Existing Privacy Policy page (marked DRAFT, owner review on the live site).

terms.note: Existing Terms of Service page (marked DRAFT, owner review on the live site).

email.note: Public NEXUS Research email already used on the live site.

test-amazon-bundle-rule-check.used_by: Current Test card 'View the Test' (Amazon Bundle Rule Check)
test-amazon-bundle-rule-check.note: Existing Amazon Bundle Rule Check page on the live site. That page has the live Stripe checkout; this preview itself takes no payments.
